# Appropriation Ordinance No. 02, Series of 2018 — Annual Budget for Fiscal Year 2019

## Summary

This appropriation ordinance enacts the Annual Budget of the [[Municipality of Pitogo]], [[Quezon Province]] for Fiscal Year 2019, approved via Resolution No. 227. The total budget amounts to P90,967,900.56. Introduced by [[Coun. Esperanza A. Tan]], the ordinance draws authority from multiple provisions of the [[Local Government Code of 1991]] governing local budgeting, financial management, and appropriations. [[Carlos T. Gliane II]] was on leave during the session.

## Key Provisions

- Appropriates P90,967,900.56 as the Annual Budget of [[Pitogo, Quezon]] for Fiscal Year 2019.
- Approved as Resolution No. 227 of the Sangguniang Bayan.
- Complies with the budgeting requirements under Title V of the [[Local Government Code of 1991]].
- [[Carlos T. Gliane II]] — Absent (On Leave).
